facts.title: uncontrolled movement of P-4103 during shift handover

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-4103, PT-4103 and TT-4103 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-4103, PT-4103 and TT-4103 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically replacing seals and seal support fluid. P-4103 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during shift handover while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 3 December 2012 an incident occurred on P-4103, PT-4103 and TT-4103 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
